name: Shadowy Passage
desc1: Pitchblack stones encase you in this passageway, giving you a feeling
desc2: of great unease. The rock seems to lash out at any form of light that
desc3: is found, and most chilling of all the passage is silent like that of
desc4: a coffin. Large black doors stand in your path, as if challenging you
desc5: to dare open them, unleashing whatever dark secret they hide.
